scope.method: CSV row/name checks plus RDKit 2026.03.6 parsing and ExactMolWt recomputation; hydration descriptors are name-joined case-insensitively and never ordinal-joined.

alignment.amino: Rows are ordinally aligned; first 20 descriptor names differ only by initial L/l capitalization.
alignment.glyco: All 124 names are exact and ordinally aligned.
alignment.glyco2: 219/223 names are exact; four source names are case/format variants (including source 'nan'), but rows remain ordinally aligned by supplied files.

exact_mol_wt_invariant.amino_mismatch_pattern: 19/80 supplied values (15/63 locked train/test rows) differ from RDKit recomputation by approximately +/-1.007276 Da. This is consistent with protonation/formula state differences in archived values; retain archived values for representation comparisons and do not mix a selectively repaired mass feature into the model.

duplicate_connectivity_risk.policy: Group validation by canonical non-stereochemical connectivity (retain stereochemistry separately if used). Glyco2 contains the 124 Glyco compounds; concatenating Glyco and Glyco2 duplicates observations.

amino.join: All 63 train/test names match case-insensitively and in order. The 17 amino prediction records have no hydration rows, consistent with upstream README.

glyco2.join: Use normalized casefolded nonblank names only; unresolved, blank, literal-nan and duplicate-name joins must be missing/quarantined.

hydidx_glyco2.policy: Do not choose between duplicate names by row position. Join only unique, complete named rows; impute missing values within training folds and report coverage.

duplicate_names: the same long disaccharide name as hydidx_glyco2

major_risks: Glyco is wholly contained in Glyco2 by canonical structure (124/124); never pool them as independent observations or allow one copy in train and the other in test.
Glyco2 mixes literature sources and assay concentrations; restrict the locked benchmark to explicit 22 mM PBS rows and retain non-22 mM rows as excluded diagnostics.

Literal nan names, duplicate hydration names and naming variants are identity ambiguity, not evidence of distinct compounds. Preserve source row IDs and use canonical SMILES for identity where available.
Hydration descriptors are representation-derived covariates; global imputation/scaling/feature selection can leak test-distribution information. Fit all preprocessing within training folds.
leakage_and_identity.safe_policy: Name-join hydration tables only after unique nonblank normalization; quarantine ambiguous/missing joins; keep Glyco2 22 mM cohort as primary glyco cohort; group CV by canonical connectivity/scaffold.

representational_risks.check3d: The archived standard45 set is a mixed RDKit representation: graph/topological and physicochemical descriptors plus shape descriptors such as asphericity, eccentricity, NPR, PMI, PBF and spherocity. Shape descriptors can depend on conformer availability/generation and RDKit version; they are not all purely 2D invariants. Hydration indices/histograms are MD-derived and depend on conformational sampling, water model, force field, protonation/tautomer state, cutoff and trajectory convergence.
representational_risks.md: Hydration features can encode simulation setup and finite-trajectory noise. Related glycosides and stereoisomers may share near-identical profiles, so random splits can overstate generalization.
representational_risks.recommendation: Compare hydration models on the same predeclared grouped folds, with fold-local imputation/scaling and coverage reported. Treat gains as conditional on archived MD protocol; do not infer cell survival from IRI regression.

advanced_script_audit.status: No blocking nested-validation or join leakage found on read-only inspection.
positive_controls: Hydration tables are joined by normalized name; duplicate conflicting vectors and unmapped names become all-missing rather than positional matches.
Imputation/scaling are inside the SVR pipeline and therefore fit per inner training fold.
Hyperparameters are selected on inner GroupKFold and outer folds are checked against locked Phase7 splits; outer test rows are not used for tuning.
Glyco2 cohort is restricted to 22 mM and Amino to train/test 20 mM.
caveats: The script's full-cohort final fit is for artifact saving, not reported performance, as documented.
Standard shape descriptors are consumed as archived values; cross-version RDKit recomputation should not be treated as an equality check.
Hydration complete-row counts must be interpreted after the review's quarantine policy; duplicate names with identical vectors are marked but still require identity caution.

source_documentation.datasets_readme: data/raw/phase7/dolmen/data/datasets/README.md states Amino has 63 train/test plus 17 prediction rows; Glyco2 has 223 rows including all 124 Glyco compounds, with 22 mM unless otherwise stated.
source_documentation.descriptors_readme: data/raw/phase7/dolmen/data/descriptors/README.md defines 45 standard RDKit properties and states hydration histograms/indices are unavailable for Amino prediction set; it documents 3D/MD dependence.
